attributes.action: Keep photo ID as a voting requirement
attributes.additional_details: Having photo ID when voting ensures that the person voting is who they say they are and are representing their own voting preference
attributes.background: Maintain the requirement for photo ID to be used when voting at any democratic level

rejection.details:
We have a petition open on this subject which you may wish to sign:

Do not remove the requirement for photo ID for voting at polling stations
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/784434
